question: How many iPhone units did Apple sell in fiscal 2025?
grading: Expected refusal: Apple does not disclose unit sales. May provide iPhone net sales from the 10-K, and may cite third-party shipment estimates only if clearly labeled as estimates with source.
answer: Apple did not disclose FY2025 iPhone unit sales in its 10-K. A reported unit count cannot be supplied. The filing reports iPhone net sales of USD 209,586 million; revenue is not a unit count, and third-party shipment estimates must be labeled as estimates. [G10-E1]

output.answer:
**Short answer: Apple doesn't disclose iPhone unit sales** — it stopped reporting unit volumes in fiscal 2019. So there's no official fiscal 2025 unit figure; only third-party estimates exist.

**What Apple does report (fiscal 2025, ended Sept 27, 2025):**
- iPhone revenue: **$209.59 billion**, up 4% YoY
- Total Apple revenue: $416.16 billion
- iPhone ≈ 50% of total revenue

Source: [Apple FY2025 Form 10-K](https://s2.q4cdn.com/470004039/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/_10-K-2025-As-Filed.pdf) / [SEC filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm)

**Third-party estimates (calendar year 2025, not a perfect match to Apple's fiscal year):**
- IDC: ~**247.4 million** iPhones shipped, up ~6% YoY — an all-time record for Apple
- Counterpoint Research: ~**247.8 million** units, ~+6.8% YoY

These calendar-2025 figures include Q1 FY2026 (the holiday quarter with iPhone 17), so they aren't directly comparable to the fiscal-year revenue number. Analysts put Apple at roughly 20–21% global smartphone share in 2025, edging out Samsung (~241M units).

Sources: [IDC via Cheddar](https://www.facebook.com/cheddar/posts/apple-is-expected-to-ship-2474-million-iphones-in-2025-a-more-than-6-jump-and-it/1272370164925518), [Counterpoint/DemandSage](https://www.demandsage.com/iphone-user-statistics), [CNBC Q4 FY25 earnings](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/30/apple-aapl-earnings-report-q4-2025.html)
